notes.title: 14 July Update - New Gems!!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40426326/9f53de78aafbf5cb4c38eea7c16a9cb62fee5b2a.gif
Main Changes:
[olist]
 The gems on the board are new and different from one another.
 Gem Frenzy intro animation added; inspired by Dreamcast-era games.
 First game check - turns off research and mining for your first game (if you want).
 Major notification panel - UI animation when major things happen, i.e. a tower is destroyed.
 Next closest gem info - In Gem Frenzy, your Lazarr Gun now shows the gem closest to completion.
[/olist]
